about: Attacks on the shell side of the delegation guard, written before each fix. expect deny = a hole that must stay closed; expect allow = a false refusal that was lifted. old = the verdict before the fix. Replayed by tests/guard_probes.py with GUARD_PROBES_DATA pointing here; one fresh FRUGALFLOW_HOME per probe, no receipt. Paths are neutral. Shell expansion, shell keywords, brace lists and sed scripts are judged; the last probes carry a fresh receipt for lib/a.py: a receipt covers only its exact file, an unreadable target is refused.
